_note: One tip is shown per day on the homepage, rotating automatically. Keep each under 40 words.
tips: Check your KYC status on MF Central before every new purchase. A status that was fine last year can drop to On Hold after a records revalidation.
Verify your email with your KRA, not just your mobile. Overseas numbers often fail SMS verification; email OTP rarely does.
The name on your PAN must match your passport letter for letter. Initials versus full names is the most common reason video KYC fails.
Keep a notarised copy of your passport and overseas address proof in a folder. You will need them again for banks, brokers and fund houses.
Moved abroad? Change every folio's tax status to NRI before you redeem, not after. Resident-status folios can be frozen at redemption.
Money earned abroad belongs in NRE. Money earned in India belongs in NRO. Mixing them makes repatriation harder later.
NRE and FCNR interest is tax-free in India but usually taxable where you live. Report it locally.
Withholding on equity gains usually ignores the ₹1.25 lakh annual exemption. File an Indian return to reclaim the difference.
Send your Tax Residency Certificate and Form 10F to fund houses before dividend record dates, not after. Treaty rates cannot be applied retroactively by the payer.
US persons: an Indian mutual fund is usually a PFIC. Run the numbers before buying, not at tax time.
FBAR counts the highest balance of every foreign account during the year, including demat and mutual fund accounts, not just year-end values.
Canadian residents: Indian deposits, shares and fund units all count toward the CAD 100,000 T1135 threshold.
Your passport should have six months' validity when you open accounts. Renew first if you are close.
Shares bought with NRE money can be sold and the proceeds sent abroad in full. Shares bought with NRO money cannot, beyond the USD 1 million yearly limit.
Intraday trading is not allowed for NRIs. Every purchase must be taken into delivery.
Before a large transfer home, compare your bank's quoted rate with the market rate. The difference is the bank's margin.
Keep the broker's annual capital gains statement and the fund house tax statement. Your home-country preparer will ask for both.
Joint NRE accounts can include a resident relative only on a former-or-survivor basis. Plan nominations accordingly.
Returning to India? You may be RNOR for two or three years, during which most foreign income stays outside Indian tax.
From 3 December 2026, NRIs in FATF-compliant countries can complete KYC entirely from abroad. Ask your broker when its digital flow goes live.
IPO applications by NRIs usually work through net-banking ASBA from NRE or NRO accounts, since UPI needs an Indian mobile number.
A lower deduction certificate must be applied for before the payment. It cannot fix tax already withheld.
Fund houses that accept US and Canada residents change their rules without notice. Confirm before you courier forms.
OCI cardholders cannot buy agricultural land, but can invest in listed shares and mutual funds much like NRIs.
Your residential status for tax depends on days in India, not your passport or OCI card. Count your days every year.
UAE and Singapore residents pay little or no local tax on Indian gains, so recovering excess Indian TDS matters more.
UK residents: most Indian mutual funds are not UK reporting funds, so gains are usually taxed as income.
Australian residents can generally apply the 50% CGT discount to Indian shares held 12 months or more, and claim an offset for Indian tax.
Never share OTPs, passwords or card numbers with anyone offering to fix your KYC. Legitimate help never needs them.
Update your FATCA/CRS declaration when you change country. A mismatch with your KYC address can freeze an account.
